steps.title: Prepare keratinocyte growth media
steps.instruction: Thaw the Keratinocyte Growth kit at 4 °C for 1 h, warm L‑glutamine at 35 °C until fully dissolved, then add the kit components to 485 mL dermal cell basal medium in a BSC, resuspend 15–20 times with a 10 mL pipette, and store at 4 °C (max 30 days).

steps.title: Thaw and seed keratinocytes
steps.instruction: Bring complete growth media to room temperature (30 min–1 h), calculate required cell volume for 5,000–8,000 cells/cm² (e.g., 0.25 mL for 500,000 cells in a T‑75), disinfect flasks with 70 % ethanol, add 15 mL media, incubate 30 min at 37 °C/5 % CO₂, thaw cryovial, add 1 mL pre‑warmed media, gently resuspend, transfer to 15 mL tube, centrifuge 150 × g 3 min, discard supernatant, add 1 mL fresh media, resuspend, add appropriate volume to flask, rock flask 10 × horizontal and vertical, incubate 48 h at 37 °C/5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Passage keratinocytes
steps.instruction: Confirm 70‑75 % confluence (10×), bring media, DPBS, trypsin‑EDTA, and neutralizer to RT, disinfect work area, remove media, rinse with 5 mL DPBS (twice if needed), add 5 mL pre‑warmed trypsin‑EDTA, rock ≤2 min, discard 4 mL to avoid over‑exposure, observe rounding (≤10 min), tap flask, add equal volume neutralizer, transfer to 50 mL tube, verify detachment, centrifuge 150 × g 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 mL complete media, take 20 µL for Trypan blue count, calculate seeding volume for 2,500–5,000 cells/cm², add 15 mL fresh media to new flasks, seed calculated volume, incubate 30 min then 37 °C/5 % CO₂ 24–48 h.

steps.title: Maintain keratinocyte cultures
steps.instruction: Warm complete media to RT (30 min–1 h), remove flasks, disinfect with 70 % ethanol, discard old media, add 15 mL fresh pre‑warmed media, incubate 48 h, repeat media change every 48 h until 70‑75 % confluence, then passage.

steps.title: Thaw and seed fibroblasts
steps.instruction: Warm cryovial in hands, calculate volume for 2,500–5,000 cells/cm² (e.g., 0.25 mL for 500,000 cells), disinfect flasks, add 15 mL fibroblast growth media, incubate 30 min at 37 °C/5 % CO₂ (pause point allowed), thaw cryovial, add 1 mL pre‑warmed media, resuspend gently, transfer to 15 mL tube, centrifuge 220 × g 3 min, discard supernatant, add 1 mL fresh media, resuspend, add 15 mL fresh fibroblast growth media to T‑75, seed calculated volume, incubate 48 h at 37 °C/5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Passage fibroblasts
steps.instruction: Check 80 % confluence, bring growth medium, HBSS, trypsin‑EDTA, neutralizer to RT, disinfect, remove media, rinse with 5 mL HBSS (repeat if needed), add 5 mL pre‑warmed trypsin‑EDTA, rock ≤2 min, discard 4 mL, observe rounding (≤10 min), tap base, add equal neutralizer, transfer to 50 mL tube, verify detachment, centrifuge 220 × g 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 mL fibroblast growth media, take 20 µL for Trypan blue count, calculate seeding volume for 2,500–5,000 cells/cm², add 15 mL fresh pre‑warmed media to new flasks, seed calculated volume, incubate 48 h at 37 °C/5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Maintain fibroblast cultures
steps.instruction: Warm growth medium to RT (30 min–1 h), remove flasks, disinfect with 70 % ethanol, discard old media, add 15 mL fresh pre‑warmed medium, incubate 48 h at 37 °C/5 % CO₂, repeat every 48 h until 80 % confluence, then passage.

steps.title: Prepare customized media
steps.instruction: Thaw HKGS and LSGS at 4 °C (overnight), let DMEM reach RT, add 5 mL HKGS and 10 mL LSGS to DMEM bottle in BSC, mix with 10 mL pipette, store at 4 °C (max 30 days).

steps.title: Switch cells to customized media
steps.instruction: Remove flasks from incubator, disinfect with 70 % ethanol, discard old media, pre‑warm customized media to RT, add 15 mL to each T‑75 flask, return to incubator 37 °C/5 % CO₂ for 48 h; repeat media change every 48 h until desired confluence before printing.

steps.title: Passage cells in customized media
steps.instruction: Assess confluence (HEKa 70‑75 %, HDF 80 %), bring customized media, HBSS/DPBS, trypsin‑EDTA, neutralizer to RT, remove media, rinse with 5 mL HBSS or DPBS (repeat if needed), add 5 mL pre‑warmed trypsin‑EDTA, rock ≤2 min, discard 4 mL, observe rounding (<10 min), tap base, add equal neutralizer (type‑specific), transfer to 50 mL tube, verify detachment, centrifuge 150 × g 5 min (HEKa) or 220 × g 5 min (HDF), discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 mL customized media, take 20 µL for Trypan blue count, calculate seeding volume for 2,500–5,000 cells/cm², add 15 mL fresh pre‑warmed customized media to new flasks, seed calculated volume, incubate 48 h at 37 °C/5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare HDF bioink
steps.instruction: Thaw TissuePrint Component 1 and Component 3 at 4 °C (overnight). Count HDFs (2 × 10⁶ cells / mL bioink; e.g., 4 × 10⁶ cells → 2 mL bioink). Centrifuge cells 220 × g 5 min, disinfect tube with 70 % ethanol, keep in BSC. Mix Component 2 with Component 1 in 50 mL tube, disperse clumps with wide‑bore pipette. Remove supernatant from cell pellet, add 1 mL Component 3 (RT) to cells, resuspend gently, then add remaining Component 3, gently mix. Slowly add cell‑Component 3 mixture to Component 1 + 2 using a 1 mL tip, pipette up/down to homogenize. Use bioink within 1 h; keep excess on ice.

steps.title: Prepare HEKa bioink
steps.instruction: Thaw TissuePrint Component 1 and Component 3 at 4 °C (overnight). Count HEKa (2 × 10⁶ cells / mL; calculate volume). Centrifuge cells 150 × g 5 min, disinfect tube with 70 % ethanol, keep in BSC. Mix Component 2 with Component 1 in 50 mL tube, disperse clumps. Remove supernatant, add 1 mL Component 3 (RT) to cells, resuspend gently, then add remaining Component 3, mix gently. Slowly add cell‑Component 3 mixture to Component 1 + 2 with a 1 mL tip, pipette up/down. Use bioink within 1 h; keep excess on ice.

steps.title: Prepare TissuePrint crosslinker
steps.instruction: Thaw Component A and Component B at 4 °C (overnight). In BSC, add Component B to Component A, mix with pipette. Use 20 mL crosslinker per 5 mL bioink. Store at 4 °C; shelf‑life 1 week.

steps.title: Prepare 0.5 % agarose support
steps.instruction: Measure 150 mL distilled water in autoclavable container, add magnetic stir bar, weigh 750 mg Froggarose, add to water, autoclave 30 min at 121 °C, stir at ~700 rpm while cooling, leave stirring overnight, store at 4 °C until use.

steps.title: Autoclave bioprinting equipment
steps.instruction: Autoclave all equipment shown in Figure 3A (conical racks, beakers, spatulas, Luer locks, 22G needles, 3 mL cartridges, 5 mL syringes) the day before printing; after autoclave, transfer items into BSC for UV sterilization.

steps.title: Sterilize BIO X printer
steps.instruction: Place BIO X printer inside sterile BSC, decontaminate printer and BSC, turn on printer, run UV sterilization cycle inside printer (room vacated, wear UV protective glasses), then UV‑sterilize entire BSC.

steps.title: Load bioink into printer cartridges
steps.instruction: Pour prepared bioink into sterile 10 mL syringe (bottom filled, use spatula if needed), attach syringe to empty 3 mL cartridge via sterilized Luer lock, push plunger to load bioink, keep 5 mL syringe upright to let bubbles rise, unscrew pneumatic syringe, attach 22G needle tip, insert pneumatic syringe into BIO X printhead, screw top to pressure connector.

steps.title: Set printer parameters and calibrate
steps.instruction: Turn on BIO X, press Bioprint, select print file (construct 10 × 10 × 5 mm), choose 6‑well plate as surface, set Tool 1 and Tool 2 to pneumatic 3 mL, start with speed 15 mm/s and pressure 11 kPa, upload layer profile (perimeter) and select honeycomb 30 % infill, assign Tool 1 to dermal layers (HDF) and Tool 2 to epidermal layers (HEKa), test extrusion of each printhead and adjust pressure, calibrate each printhead to same Z‑height in the well.

steps.title: Bioprint constructs
steps.instruction: Fill each well of a 6‑well plate with ~2 mL 0.5 % agarose support (just over half well depth), test extrusion and confirm speed 15 mm/s, pressure 11 kPa, press Start to print, monitor speed/pressure and adjust as needed, after printing remove plate from bed.

steps.title: Crosslink printed constructs
steps.instruction: Fill 10 mL syringe with crosslinker, attach 22G needle, slowly inject 2–5 mL crosslinker around each construct in a circle without touching the construct, let sit 20–30 min until construct becomes whitish and holds shape.

steps.title: Rinse constructs with sterile TBS
steps.instruction: Filter sterile TBS through 0.2 µm filter, add TBS to a separate empty 6‑well plate, use metal spatula to gently agitate and lift construct from agarose, slide spatula under construct, transfer construct into TBS‑filled well to rinse excess agarose.

steps.title: Transfer constructs to customized media
steps.instruction: Place rinsed construct into a 12‑well plate containing enough customized media to fully cover it, incubate at 37 °C/5 % CO₂; proceed to bacterial infection within 48 h.

steps.title: Prepare bacterial cultures
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony of S. aureus or S. epidermidis from TSA plate, inoculate 5 mL TBS, shake 200 rpm overnight (16–18 h), add 1 mL overnight culture to 50 mL sterile TSB in 250 mL flask, incubate 4 h at 37 °C shaking, harvest 10 mL, centrifuge 4,000 × g 7 min, wash pellet with 1× PBS, resuspend in 10 mL PBS, adjust OD₆₀₀ to 0.1 (≈5 × 10⁸ CFU/mL).

steps.title: Inoculate constructs with bacteria
steps.instruction: Using a 27 G × 3/4″ needle attached to a 1 mL syringe, inject 50 µL S. aureus and/or 50 µL S. epidermidis into the center of each construct (≈½ depth). OD 0.1 corresponds to 5 × 10⁸ CFU/mL; inject total 5 × 10⁷ CFU per construct (2.5 × 10⁷ CFU each strain), equivalent to ~3.33 × 10⁸ CFU/cm³ for a 150 µL construct. Incubate constructs at 37 °C/5 % CO₂ for 24 h or 72 h as required.

steps.title: Harvest and homogenize infected constructs
steps.instruction: Aseptically remove each construct with forceps, rinse once in 1× PBS, place in 1 mL PBS + 0.1 % Triton X‑100, homogenize through a 100 µm cell strainer using a 1 mL syringe plunger (or equivalent flat sterile surface) to fully dissociate scaffold and cells, collect 1 mL homogenate for bacterial enumeration.

steps.title: Enumerate bacteria from constructs
steps.instruction: Perform 10‑fold serial dilutions of homogenate up to 10⁻⁸, plate 10 µL of each dilution onto mannitol salt agar (duplicate), incubate plates 48 h at 30 °C; identify S. aureus colonies (yellow) and S. epidermidis colonies (pink) and count CFU.
